Rationale.RP1_ImplementationReconstructability: The experiment was fully reconstructed from plan.md and CodeWalkthrough.md. The repository contains clear methodology description, well-organized source code with modular design, demo notebooks showing complete workflows, and pre-computed hyperparameters. No significant guesswork was required.
Rationale.RP2_EnvironmentReproducibility: Environment setup was successful with Python 3.11, PyTorch 2.7.1+cu118, and Transformers 4.57.3. All dependencies were available, GPT-J model loaded from HuggingFace, and GPU (NVIDIA H200) was utilized. The requirements.txt provides adequate dependency specification.
Rationale.RP3_DeterminismAndStability: Results are reproducible with seed control via experiment_utils.set_seed(). Consistent results across runs with deterministic Jacobian computation. While exact numbers differ from original paper (due to default vs optimized hyperparameters), the patterns and relationships between metrics are consistent with original findings.
Rationale.RP4_DemoPresentation: Repository includes comprehensive demos (demo/demo.ipynb, demo/attribute_lens.ipynb, notebooks/evaluate_demo.ipynb) that are executable without external materials, specify required inputs and configurations, demonstrate main experimental claims, and match documented results within expected variation.
